tasks: Prep 4 overnight oats jars: per jar — 1/2 cup rolled oats + 1 scoop vanilla protein powder + 1/3 cup Greek yogurt + 2/3 cup almond milk + 1 tbsp chia seeds; stir well; refrigerate overnight; morning-of: top with sliced strawberries + blueberries + 1 tbsp almond butter (Austin) or 1 tbsp coconut flakes (Cameron)

batch_prep.station: SATURDAY — DRY BRINE PORK TENDERLOIN (5 min)
tasks: 2 pork tenderloins (~1.5 lbs each) — pat dry; mix 1 tbsp kosher salt + 1 tsp smoked paprika + 1 tsp garlic powder + 1/2 tsp black pepper + 1/2 tsp cayenne; rub all over; place on wire rack over sheet pan; refrigerate uncovered overnight for crisp bark

Heat smoker to 250°F using cherry wood chips; place dry-brined pork tenderloins on grate; smoke 1.5–2 hrs until internal temp hits 145°F; last 20 min: brush with Cherry BBQ Glaze (see sauce station) every 10 min for lacquer; pull at 145°F; rest 10 min tented; slice — reserve 1/3 for Sunday lunch grain bowls, remaining 2/3 for Saturday dinner with extra glaze on the side

batch_prep.station: BREVILLE OVEN — BATCH CHICKEN THIGHS (prep 15 min | roast 35 min)
tasks: 5 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs — pat dry; season half (2.5 lbs) with olive oil + harissa paste + lemon zest + garlic + cumin for Mediterranean bowls + harissa dinner; season other half (2.5 lbs) with olive oil + gochujang + soy sauce + ginger + garlic for lettuce wraps + enchilada bowls; roast all at 400°F for 32–35 min; cool 10 min; slice or shred; label clearly: 'HARISSA' and 'GOCHUJANG'

batch_prep.station: OVEN — ZUCCHINI-TURKEY SAUSAGE EGG BITES (prep 12 min | bake 22 min)
tasks: 12-cup muffin tin greased; whisk 10 egg whites + 4 whole eggs + 6 oz turkey sausage crumbles + 1 cup shredded zucchini (squeeze out excess moisture!) + 4 sliced spring onions + 2 oz crumbled feta + 1/2 tsp garlic powder + 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes + salt + pepper; fill cups 3/4 full; bake 375°F for 20–22 min until puffed and set; cool fully; store airtight 5 days
Austin: 4 bites per morning | Cameron: 3 bites + avocado side
3 cups dry jasmine rice — makes ~7.5 cups cooked; used for enchilada verde bowls (Tue), Thai coconut shrimp (Wed), gochujang lettuce wraps (Wed/Thu), and Sunday grain bowls; portion and fridge
2 cups dry quinoa — makes ~4 cups cooked; used for Mediterranean bowls Mon/Tue; portion and fridge
Cook 8 oz dry linguine per package; drain, toss with 1 tsp olive oil; portion for Fri dinner (dress day-of)

CHERRY BBQ GLAZE: 1/2 lb fresh cherries (pitted + roughly chopped) + 1/4 cup BBQ sauce + 2 tbsp honey + 1 tbsp red wine vinegar + 1/2 tsp smoked paprika + pinch cayenne; simmer 15 min stirring occasionally until cherries break down; blend smooth or leave chunky; jar and fridge — use for smoker baste + serving sauce
LEMON-HERB DRESSING (Med bowls): 3 tbsp olive oil + 2 tbsp lemon juice + 1 tsp Dijon + 1/2 tsp garlic powder + 1 tbsp fresh oregano (or 1 tsp dried) + salt + pepper; whisk; jar and fridge
GOCHUJANG GLAZE (lettuce wraps): 2 tbsp gochujang + 1 tbsp soy sauce + 1 tbsp honey + 1 tsp sesame oil + 1 tsp rice vinegar + 1/2 tsp garlic powder; whisk; jar and fridge
TZATZIKI (Sun Greek dinner + grain bowls): 1 cup Greek yogurt + 1/2 grated cucumber (squeeze dry) + 1 clove garlic minced + 1 tbsp fresh dill + 1 tbsp lemon juice + salt; stir; fridge 4 days
SALSA VERDE CREMA (Tue enchilada bowls): 1 cup tomatillo salsa + 1/4 cup Greek yogurt + juice of 1 lime + pinch cumin; blend; fridge
2x Mediterranean Chicken Cucumber Grain Bowl per person — Mon/Tue (keep dressing separate; Cameron gets avocado separate)
2x Gochujang Chicken Lettuce Wraps per person — Wed/Thu (butter lettuce + pickled cucumber in separate container; Cameron less gochujang + avocado)
2x Italian Zucchini Chicken Pesto Pasta Salad per person — Fri/Sat (dress day-of with pesto; Cameron gets avocado separately)
1x Smoked Pork Grain Bowl — Sun (assemble from Saturday's smoker pork)
NEVER put avocado in any container labeled A — Austin allergy
Cameron avocados: 5 whole avocados — store at room temp until ripe, then fridge; slice fresh daily
